overview: This 364-page file documents Allied negotiations and implementation of the postwar disposal of Japan’s navy. Diplomatic notes, policy reports, and ship inventories trace the destruction of larger warships, the four-power division of smaller combat vessels, their delivery and temporary use for repatriation, and disputes over Soviet requests and other countries’ claims.
interest: Drafts, inventories, and diplomatic replies reveal how an Allied agreement became ship allocations amid competing claims and occupation needs.
